name: freecad-render-pipeline
description: Turn FreeCAD 2D drawings and BIM/Arch models into photorealistic renders. Ships a working local pipeline (FreeCAD glTF/OBJ export -> Blender/Cycles photoreal render, auto-framed camera + lighting, zero extra accounts) plus a Python MCP server (FastMCP, stdio) exposing both that pipeline and a thin, honest client for Coohom's partner-gated Open API (the cloud interior-design/render platform commonly typed "Cohoom") that never fabricates connectivity to an unfilled endpoint. 3 stdlib-only CLI scripts (export, render, Coohom client) + 1 mcp-SDK MCP server, 3 references citing FreeCAD wiki / Blender API docs / Coohom's own public API-design-standard page, cs-freecad-render agent, /cs:render-freecad command.
